# kinde_environment_feature_flags (Resource)

Overrides feature flag values for the environment the provider is authenticated against. Only the flags listed in `flags` are managed; overrides set outside Terraform on other flags are left alone. Declare this resource once per environment. See [documentation](https://docs.kinde.com/kinde-apis/management/#tag/environments) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kinde_environment_feature_flags" "this" {
  flags = {
    dark_mode = "true"
    max_seats = "25"
    theme     = "pink"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flags` (Map of String) Override values keyed by feature flag key. Values are strings in the form Kinde returns them, e.g. `"true"` or `"false"` for boolean flags and `"42"` for integer flags. The flags must already exist.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `environment`.
